terms.seoDescription: Terms of purchase for Butik Lyktan – company details, payment, delivery, right of withdrawal and complaints.
terms.title: Terms of purchase
terms.intro: These terms apply to purchases in our web shop. Buying in the shop at Veddestabron 8B is covered by ordinary Swedish consumer law.

sections.heading: Company details
body: Lyktan Spel AB, company registration number 559541-9564.

sections.heading: Prices and VAT
body: All prices are in Swedish kronor and include VAT. Any shipping cost is added and shown before you complete your purchase.
We reserve the right for sold-out items and for obvious errors in price or stock. If something is wrong we contact you before processing the order.

sections.heading: Payment
body: Payment is made at checkout using the methods shown there. Your order is binding once payment has gone through and you have received an order confirmation by email.

sections.heading: Delivery and pickup
body: For now you collect your order in the shop at Veddestabron 8B. We let you know when it is ready and hold it for at least fourteen days.
Shipping with PostNord opens shortly. Shipping cost and delivery method are always shown before you complete your purchase.

sections.heading: Right of withdrawal
body: You have fourteen days to withdraw from your purchase from the day you receive the goods, under Swedish distance selling law. Email hej@butiklyktan.se and we refund you within fourteen days of receiving the item back.

You may examine the item as you would have in a shop. If it has been used or handled beyond that, we may deduct for the reduction in value. Sealed booster packs and card products that have been opened can therefore rarely be returned for a full refund.
The right of withdrawal does not apply to event tickets, as these concern a leisure activity on a set date. If you cannot make it, get in touch and we will sort it out if we can.

sections.heading: Complaints
body: If an item is faulty you may file a complaint for up to three years under the Swedish Consumer Sales Act. Email hej@butiklyktan.se as soon as you discover the fault and we will put it right.
We cover return shipping for an approved complaint.

sections.heading: If we cannot agree
body: If we cannot find a solution you can turn to the Swedish National Board for Consumer Disputes (ARN), Box 174, 101 23 Stockholm. We follow their recommendations.

sections.heading: Personal data
body: We process your data to handle your order, your event participation and our bookkeeping. We never sell it on.
To find out what data we hold about you, or to have it deleted, email hej@butiklyktan.se.
